title: Nucleic Acid Purification: Bead Clean
author: Madeline Y Mayday
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ta5eig6
materials: Prepare all necessary reagents and bring to room temperature:

steps.title: Bind Beads to Sample
steps.instruction: Aspirate the desired volume of Ampure beads from the reservoir and mix into the sample plate by mixing the total volume minus one microliter 20 times.

steps.title: Form Magnetic Pellet
steps.instruction: Transfer the plate onto an Alpaqua 384 Post Magnet Plate using a 3D-printed adaptor and incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes to allow the magnetic pellet to form.

steps.title: Perform Ethanol Washes
steps.instruction: Wash the beads twice using 80% ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Slowly aspirate the supernatant and discard.
Aspirate 25uL of freshly prepared 80% ethanol from the reservoir and add to samples while on the magnetic rack.
Incubate at room temperature for 30 seconds.
Allow the magnetic pellet to air dry on the magnetic rack for a maximum of 90 seconds (do not overdry).

steps.title: Elute cDNA
steps.instruction: Resuspend the beads in the specified volume and type of elution buffer and mix well.

substeps.instruction: Remove plate from the magnetic stand.
Add elution buffer (Regular elution buffer for Post-Second Strand Synthesis, Post-End Prep, and Post-USER/PCR; nuclease-free water for Post-Adaptor Ligation barcodes).
Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Transfer plate onto the Alpaqua 384 Post Magnet Plate with the 3D-printed adaptor and incubate at room temperature for another 5 minutes.

steps.title: Collect Purified cDNA
steps.instruction: Slowly aspirate the supernatant containing the cDNA and transfer it to the final PCR plate.
